discovery.title: Auto-discover / rediscover devices
discovery.description: UDP broadcast on port 1337 (same as HA). Adds heaters automatically, rebinds them if their IP changes, and retries after network loss. devices[] can override name/modes per IP.

temperatureMode.title: Default current temperature sensor
temperatureMode.description: Used for discovered devices and when a device omits temperatureMode

modes.title: Default mode switches
modes.description: Used for discovered devices and when a device omits modes. Keep in sync with DEFAULT_MODES in src/settings.ts.

devices.title: Devices (optional overrides / static)
devices.description: Optional. With discovery on, entries override name/modes for a known IP and keep the device if it is offline during discover. With discovery off, only these devices are used.

ip.title: IP Address
ip.description: IP of the T-Smart / EUROICC heater (static IP recommended)

deviceId.title: Device ID (optional)
deviceId.description: Stable heater id from discovery (hex). Optional — learned automatically after first successful contact. Useful for VLAN/static setups.

modes.title: Mode switches
modes.description: Exposed as HomeKit switches. Mutually exclusive; turning all off sets Manual mode. Omit to use platform default; empty list disables mode switches.
